source.label: Source layer
source.role: The external input layer where the profile starts before any lowering rules run.

intermediate.label: Intermediate layer
intermediate.role: An internal stage in the lowering pipeline that reshapes the previous layer into a more concrete representation.

terminal.label: Terminal layer
terminal.role: The final emitted layer after all lowering rules have run.

unknown.label: Pipeline stage
unknown.role: A stage in this profile's lowering pipeline.

recipeViews.purpose: Picks a layout template for the interaction and orders each region by priority and disclosure for the target context.
Binds each presentation region to a concrete UI capability the kernel can render.
